## Answer

Four of the six clearly did, one only partly, one is not recorded:

| Paper | TMA as reactant A? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Gao 2015 | Yes | tma [gao15:recipe_fill:run_al2o3_300c:reactant_A] (run) |
| Yim 2020 | Yes — all 16 samples with x₅₀% values | e.g. tma [yim20:recipe_fill:run_ser_a:reactant_A], tma [yim20:recipe_fill:run_16:reactant_A] (run) |
| Werbrouck 2021 | Yes — all four samples with 50% depths | e.g. tma [wer21:recipe_fill:run_fig11_c1:reactant_A] (run) |
| Ylilammi 2018 | Yes | tma [yli18:s8.p21#2] (run) |
| Elam 2003 | Only for Al₂O₃ work, not for the ZnO runs that yielded the measured 50% depths | Al₂O₃ samples/recipe: tma [ela03:fig8.cap#1] (run); ZnO nanopore specimens: dez [ela03:recipe_fill:run_zno_3s:reactant_A] (run) |
| Heikkinen 2024 | Not recorded | reactant A not recorded for all 166 of its units (sphere/cylinder/slab model runs) |

## Details worth noting
- Elam 2003: the 50%-level depths I listed before come from the ZnO depositions (DEZ + H₂O) [ela03:recipe_fill:run_zno_3s:reactant_A]. Its model runs are recorded with TMA as reactant A [ela03:fig9.cap#2] (simulation) — that is the caption of the Al₂O₃ figure, applied also to the ZnO simulations, while the sim_zno numerical conditions still inherit DEZ pulse times [ela03:fig11.cap#1]. So the TMA attribution of Elam 2003's ZnO model runs is questionable; the KB does not flag it as a conflict.
- Elam 2003's TMA-based Al₂O₃ SEM specimens (1/3/10/30 s) exist in the KB, but no 50%-level penetration depth is recorded on them.
- Yim 2020 and Werbrouck 2021 matches include some conflicts flagged per sample, but these concern purge times and plasma pressure, not the first reactant (e.g. Yim 2020 sample 15: purge time 1 s at run level preferred over 4 s from recipe [yim20:fig11b#1]).
- Heikkinen 2024 is a diffusion–reaction model of porous particles; the KB records particle geometry, temperature and pressure for it, but no precursors, so its precursor cannot be stated.

Counts: 80 units with TMA as reactant A across 5 papers (Elam 2003 36, Yim 2020 21, Werbrouck 2021 21, Ylilammi 2018 1, Gao 2015 1); 193 units undecided, of which Heikkinen 2024 accounts for 166.
